newsitem.title: USA: USDA to hold public meeting on animal vaccines.
newsitem.headline: USDA to hold public meeting on animal vaccines.

text.p: The U.S. Department of Agriculture said Thursday it would hold a public meeting to discuss animal vaccines and other biological products on November 7.
The meeting will discuss draft regulations that would require licensed manufacturers to record all adverse reactions to the vaccines and biological products, USDA said.
The meeting, sponsored by USDA's Animal and Plant Health Inspection Service (APHIS), will be held at the Iowa State University's College of Veterinary Medicine in Ames, Iowa.
